next.reason: 1985: "If more than one COBOL library is available during compilation, text-name-1 must be qualified by library-name-1"; 2023: "When neither library-name-1 nor literal-2 is specified, a default COBOL library is used.". Text-name uniqueness within a library is kept. The 1985 duty to qualify when several libraries exist is gone; 2023 uses an implementor-defined default library.
